title: Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer + DevOps – Azure

**Role Overview**

We're looking for a Data Engineer with ~2 years of experience building and maintaining data pipelines on Azure, along with working knowledge of CI/CD practices to support automated, reliable deployments.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Data Factory and/or SQL-based tools
* Work with SQL Server / Azure SQL for ingestion, transformation, and storage across staging/curated/reporting layers
* Optimize pipelines and queries for performance and cost efficiency
* Collaborate with BI/analytics teams to deliver clean, reliable datasets for reporting
* Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps
* Write clean, modular, well-documented code following Git-based version control practices
* Monitor pipeline health, troubleshoot failures, and ensure data quality
* Explore opportunities to apply AI/GenAI tools for pipeline automation, data quality checks, or documentation
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering best practices

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* ~2 years of experience as a Data Engineer
* Strong hands-on experience with Azure data services (ADF, Synapse, Azure SQL, or similar)
* Proficiency in SQL and solid understanding of relational database concepts
* Working knowledge of CI/CD concepts and tools — Azure DevOps required; GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GitLab CI experience a plus
* Hands-on experience developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for development environments using Azure DevOps (ADO)
* Experience with Git-based version control and branching workflows
* Ability to write clean, modular, well-documented pipeline code
* Python for scripting
* Proficiency in PySpark and Spark SQL

**Good to Have**

* Exposure to Databricks (PySpark / Spark SQL), Delta Lake concepts
* Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Azure OpenAI, Claude Code or similar)
* Basic exposure to GenAI/LLM-based data workflows
* Basic understanding of data warehousing / dimensional modeling
* Bash/PowerShell scripting/testing
* Familiarity with Power BI or other BI tools
* Azure certifications (DP-700 Fabric Data Engineer Associate, AZ-900, etc.)
